text:
alex: quick ping — customer reported strange extra token usage when a stream reconnects and a toolcall gets truncated. Anyone seen resume + truncation produce duplicate confirmed charges?

sam: Not exactly this combo. Do we have a request id or trace? Could be provisional held on old host + new host confirming.

alex: req_20260505_13. Minimal logs: provisional=58 (host-A) -> resume to host-C -> confirmed=174, toolcall_truncated=true.

maria: That pattern matches orphaned provisional allocations. We should add provenance fields to ledger rows: provisional_id, provisional_route, resumed_session_id, toolcall_truncated.

danny: Agreed. Short-term analytics dedupe by resumed_session_id + time window (e.g., 90s). Long-term: propagate provisional_id in router headers so resumed host can claim/clear before confirming.

jen: UX: can we expose provisional vs confirmed in the request detail? Support keeps asking for origin host and timeline. Feature-flag it if needed.

sam: I'll add headers x-resume-session and x-provisional-id and emit telemetry `toolcall_truncated=true` on truncation paths. Will also ensure runtime emits a "claim" event when resumed host sees a provisional_id. ETA today.

ops-bot: Incident INF-4401 created: "resume+truncate billing investigate" (owner: eng-platform)

maria: Once telemetry lands I'll run a join query to count how often provisional_route != confirmed_route and toolcall_truncated=true. That will give scope.

danny: Draft reconcile rule: if provisional_route != confirmed_route AND toolcall_truncated=true AND confirmed_tokens >= provisional_tokens * 2, flag for manual review. We'll tune constants.

alex: Action items: sam (headers + runtime claim), jen (UI provisional row behind flag), maria (analytics join & scope), danny (reconcile playbook + tests). Post traces and query sample here.

sam: reproduced locally; trace trace_20260505_local_4 uploaded.

maria: If the query shows >0.5% of heavy accounts impacted finance wants an audit path. I'll coordinate with support.

jen: When UI lands add an "explain" link that surfaces ledger events joined by resumed_session_id to help support triage.

alex: Thanks team. Let's prioritize telemetry first so we can measure.
